q: What is the diagnosis? Describe the image.
a:

Dense, round, well-delineated ivory opacity – skull, paranasal (frontal/ethmoid) sinuses. Benign.

q: What is the diagnosis? Describe the image.
a:

Annotated: Vertical stripes

Vertebral body with coarse VERTICAL striations ("corduroy / jail-bar"); CT polka-dot; MRI bright on T1 and T2. Benign.

q: What is the diagnosis? Describe the image.
a:

Well-delineated central lytic lesion of the metaphysis in a child/adolescent, thin sclerotic rim, cortical thinning ± "fallen fragment" after fracture (simple bone cyst).
